    What to do with your file
    1. Open your usual AI, such as ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini or Copilot.
    2. Start a new chat and attach the file you downloaded.
    3. Send: “Use this brief to write the selected fields.”
    If you can’t attach a file, use “Copy brief for AI” and paste it into the chat.
